therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell exhaustion reversal and anti-tumor immune response activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell cancer

biomarker_changes: PD-L1 ≥1% CPS subgroup showed greater benefit with HR 0.74, 95% CI 0.58-0.93, p=0.00493
subgroup_findings: PD-L1 ≥1% CPS patients had improved OS (8.7 vs 7.1 months, HR 0.74)
PD-L1 ≥1% CPS patients had higher ORR (17.3% vs 9.9%, p=0.0171)
safety_signals: 30/246 patients discontinued due to AEs vs 36/234 in control
results.dose_information: 200 mg IV on Day 1 of each 3-week cycle

context.duration: up to approximately 2 years treatment and follow-up
